Description:
  Microsoft AL CLI tools

Nutzung:
  altool [command] [options]

Optionen:
  -?, -h, --help  Show help and usage information
  --version       Versionsinformationen anzeigen

Befehle:
  compile <args>                                      Compiles a package by invoking alc with the specified arguments.
  workspace                                           Workspace related commands
  GetPackageManifest, gpm <packagepath>               Get the manifest from a .app file.
  CreateSymbolPackage <sourcePath> <targetPath>       Creates a symbol package from a given application package.
  GetLatestSupportedRuntimeVersion <platformVersion>  Get latest supported AL runtime version for a platform version
  IsSymbolOnly <inputPath>                            Checks if the given .app package is a symbol-only package.
  IsRuntimePackage <inputPath>                        Checks if the given .app package is a runtime package.
  launchmcpserver <projects>                          Launch an AL Model Context Protocol (MCP) server.
  launchprofilingmcpproxy                             Launch an AL Performance Profiling MCP proxy (stdio) that captures .alcpuprofile CPU profiles from a slow Business Central session for agentic troubleshooting. The target session id is supplied per tool call.
  launchsnapshotmcpproxy                              Launch an AL Snapshot Debugging MCP proxy (stdio) that captures snapshot archives from a Business Central environment for agentic troubleshooting.
  launchlspserver <projects>                          Launch an AL Language Server Protocol (LSP) server over stdio for agentic AL development.
  publishapp <appPath>                                Publishes an AL package (.app file) to a Business Central server.
  runtests <codeunitId>                               Runs AL unit tests against a Business Central server. [default: 0]
  auth                                                Authentication helpers for cloud (Entra ID/AAD).
  graph                                               Query the AL call graph across your apps.
